name: Kovan
summary: NEL heartland hub around Kovan Hub / Heartland Mall — mature HDB density with condo inserts and a busier food belt than quieter Serangoon edges.
body: Kovan is the northeast shortlist when someone wants North-East Line access, a self-contained mall/hawker gravity, and rents under River Valley without going all the way to Punggol. Mature HDB blocks dominate; condo inserts and shop-house-adjacent food strips add weekend noise and parking pressure. Expats land here for NEL CBD hops and errand density; walk evening corridor and void-deck life before LOI if smoke or late food traffic is a sensitivity. Compare with Bartley for quieter CCL-edge living, Lorong Chuan for Circle Line condo-belt adjacency to Serangoon, and Serangoon Central when you want the full NEX interchange crush.
